title: Auna Reports Preliminary Key Performance Indicators for the Second Quarter ended June 30, 2026
summary: Auna S.A. (“Auna” or the “Company”), a leading healthcare services platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, today reported select operating metrics for the Second Quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company publishes these key performance indicators on a quarterly basis as part of its commitment to providing investors with more information and a clearer understanding of Auna.
